posts.title: Neat stats are neat
posts.description: Adam has officially released NeatStats , and I have to say, it looks, well, kinda neat! I’m not a big stats person; I do think knowing too much about your personal site is not all that healthy and can push you into weird directions, but for people who do want to get at least some basic information about the traffic they get, this looks promising. I also quite like the terminal view on the landing
